summary: Iteration 72: Verified Auto Optimization toggle feature for auto-trade settings. All 9 backend tests passed. The feature allows users to toggle auto_optimization_enabled which, when enabled, automatically applies optimal settings from signal analytics during auto-trade scans.
passed_tests: Toggle auto_optimization_enabled to False works correctly
Status response has all required fields (auto_trade_enabled, auto_optimization_enabled, settings, today_stats)
Optimal settings endpoint (/api/signal-analytics/optimal-settings) exists and returns valid response
Auto-trade scan endpoint exists and works with optimization enabled
Auto-trade scan works with optimization disabled (uses manual settings)
Multiple settings update including auto_optimization_enabled succeeds

details: Field is properly saved to database via PUT endpoint
Field is returned in GET status response
Response includes: auto_trade_enabled, auto_optimization_enabled, auto_paused, pause_reason, settings, today_stats
When auto_optimization_enabled=true, scan fetches optimal settings from signal-analytics
Falls back to manual settings if optimal settings fetch fails
Visual feedback: purple when enabled, gray when disabled
Shows 'Auto Optimize' or 'Manual' label based on state

POSITIVE: Status endpoint correctly returns auto_optimization_enabled flag
